svg.title: HadoopDelegationTokenManager -- 75% Renewal & Token Fanout
svg.desc: Submit-time HDFS token fetch, 0.75 * (renewal - now) KDC refresh, and UpdateDelegationTokens RPC fanout. 1. YARN Client to HDFS NameNode: getDelegationToken (init) (nn01:8020); 2. YarnSchedBackend to Delegation Tokens: if renewalEnabled -> start() (driver-1 in-JVM); 3. Delegation Tokens to HDFS NameNode: doLogin + getDelegationToken (nn01:8020); 4. HDFS NameNode to Delegation Tokens: Fresh HDFS_DELEGATION_TOKEN (nn01:8020); 5. Delegation Tokens to DriverSchedBackend: UpdateDelegationTokens (driver-1 in-JVM); 6. DriverSchedBackend to ExecutorBackend: UpdateDelegationTokens (driver-1:41000)

g.text: Submit-time HDFS token fetch, 0.75 * (renewal - now) KDC refresh, and UpdateDelegationTokens RPC fanout
